scope: Standalone oracle-logic prototype qualification against pinned Linux clingo. No workspace/PyO3/HTTP/service/package integration, formal theorem or specialist-panel claim.

dependency_lock.scope: Isolated standalone Cargo.lock used with --locked for final gates; shared native workspace lock unchanged.

checks.notes: All 1,225 two-atom programs with at most2 rules, checked against exhaustive reduct minimal models. Boundary fixtures use only shell builtins/no descendants and assert their owned PID is reaped after blocked-stdin timeout, stdout overflow and in-flight cancellation.
36 one-atom rule pairs compared with independent model oracle; 60 independent default pairs plus forced query succeeds within two witnesses while enumeration is inconclusive under same bound.

claims_and_limits: Each positive model is independently checked by the handwritten GL-reduct/least-Horn-fixpoint criterion. This is not an Isabelle theorem.
Query consistency and opposite-polarity UNSAT remain explicitly solver-trusted without certificates. Inconsistency never yields vacuous skeptical truth.
Any checked model contradicting an earlier UNSAT globally revokes absence-dependent answers; later timeout retains only supported witness conclusions or valid completed probes.
Adapter bounds encoded input, aggregate pipe output, checker work and deadline, stops/reaps only its own child, and assumes the pinned binary launches no descendants.

No hard address-space/RSS containment, fair multi-tenant admission, artifact-registration policy or hosted consumer is implemented by this standalone crate. CLI/system dependencies are not installed or bundled.
